messages:
Sam: LAN night tonight? Thinking 7pm in the common room. Bringing my rig but missing an ATX PSU and a couple Molex/SATA adapters — anyone have extras? @here
Priya: I have a spare PSU (Corsair 650W) and an adapter. Can drop by with them. Also: what games?
Liam: Count me in. I'll bring a Switch + Mario Party cartridge. :party_parrot:
Jordan: Heads up — the outlet by the big window tripped last month. @ops-bot do we need to avoid daisy-chaining power strips?
ops-bot: Quick FYI: recommended max draw per surge protector in common room is 13A (~1500W). Avoid >2 high-draw PCs on one strip. If you need more outlets, bring a UPS or we'll spread rigs across circuits.
Sam: Good call. Priya — could you also bring an extension and a surgeguard? If so I'll post a Steam group link and a quick poll.
Priya: Yep, got a long extension and a surgeguard.
Sam: Steam group: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/redwood-lan
Sam: Poll: react with :one: for 7pm, :two: for 8pm. Also :three: if you prefer weekend.
Liam: :one:
Jordan: :two:
Priya: :one:
Sam: Cool — leaning 7pm then. Anyone want to run a quick LAN speed test when you arrive? Command is `iperf3 -s` on host, others `iperf3 -c <host-ip> -P 4` — helps with host placement.
Liam: I'll bring a tiny 5-port switch (gigabit) in case Wi‑Fi is flaky.
Jordan: Tournament idea: 1v1 melee bracket on Smash after Mario Party. Winner gets leftover snacks. :trophy:
Priya: I can bring chips/veggies. Who wants soda?
Sam: I'll grab soda and a couple power splitters. Thanks everyone. See ya at 7! :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Note saved to #random: "LAN night — 7pm, common room. Bring adapters, avoid >1500W on one strip."
